en.headline: Chief Executive meets CSRC chairman on deepening market links
en.dek: John Lee hosted China Securities Regulatory Commission chairman Wu Qing at Government House on Sunday to discuss closer financial cooperation between Hong Kong and the mainland.
body: Chief Executive John Lee met China Securities Regulatory Commission chairman Wu Qing at Government House on Sunday to exchange views on deepening mutual access between the Hong Kong and mainland financial markets.

Lee welcomed the CSRC delegation and said Hong Kong enjoys unique advantages under “one country, two systems” as a highly internationalised market with mature financial infrastructure. He noted that the national 15th Five-Year Plan supports Hong Kong’s role as an international financial centre, global offshore renminbi hub, and international asset and risk-management centre.

The Chief Executive highlighted Monday’s launch of China Government Bond Futures as a key step in enriching the renminbi product ecosystem and attracting international investors to hold mainland bonds longer term. He expressed hope for continued cooperation with mainland regulators to enhance offshore renminbi liquidity and steadily advance renminbi internationalisation.

Financial Secretary Paul Chan, Acting Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Joseph Chan, Securities and Futures Commission chairman Tim Lui and SFC chief executive Julia Leung also attended the meeting.

zh.headline: 李家超晤中證監主席吳清 商討深化兩地金融互聯互通
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超周日在禮賓府與中國證券監督管理委員會主席吳清會面，就深化香港與內地金融市場互聯互通交流意見。
body: 行政長官李家超周日在禮賓府與中國證券監督管理委員會主席吳清會面，雙方就深化香港與內地金融市場互聯互通交換意見。
李家超歡迎吳清率團訪港。他表示，香港在「一國兩制」下享有背靠祖國、聯通世界的獨特優勢，擁有高度國際化的市場環境和成熟的金融基建。國家「十五五」規劃支持香港鞏固提升國際金融中心地位，強化全球離岸人民幣業務樞紐、國際資產及財富管理中心、國際風險管理中心功能。
李家超特別提到今日推出的國債期貨，指此舉有助吸引國際投資者參與內地債券市場及長期持有人民幣國債，是完善人民幣產品生態圈的關鍵一步。他期望與內地繼續深化合作，提高離岸人民幣流動性，穩慎扎實推進人民幣國際化。
財政司司長陳茂波、署理財經事務及庫務局局長陳浩濂、證監會主席黃天祐及行政總裁梁鳳儀亦有出席會面。
